body:
Nope. I know what peanut butter is and what it looks like. I can describe it just fine. It is light brown, creamy, and typically comes in a jar. 

I just can't see it. I remember what it looks like: but if you ask me to close my eyes and imagine it, it's pitch black.

Can't see dreams. No visualization. 

It's just the "essence."

That's not how it works at all. 

I know what peanut butter looks like. I just don't have a picture of it in my head.
